confirmed_observations: The original layer-24 direction already had high label-projection AUC; classification separability did not ensure writing control.
The selected generation direction is the normalized mean contrast of 128 positive/negative writing-intent pairs, at block 28. It is not the original RFM/AGOP direction.
All factual prefixes and their generated token IDs match zero exactly under opinion-only steering, on the 64 held-out and 32 replay sources.
The semantic judge identified both target film opinions for 55/64 new sources: 24/32 real reviews and 31/32 synthetic plots. Whole-text TFIDF, CNN and BERT separation also improved.
Texts remain imperfect: a positive review invents a small-town setting; some contrastive wording is awkward; the common baseline summary can be ambiguous.

Ten automatic positive fact flags were read post-hoc. One is a clear new setting, while nine appear to confuse changed film opinion with plot error. The automatic labels are retained; no corrected factual accuracy is claimed.
current_protocol_refinement: FACT:/REVIEW: common untargeted format. Only after the generated REVIEW: marker is consumed, add the vector. All text is generated in a single autoregressive pass; none is replaced.

failed_protocols.reason: A requested newline was absent on some real reviews. The opinion gate did not fire, and the prefix assertion failed. All 336 generated outputs were preserved remotely.
